beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The community constitution governs rights, authority, appeals, and changes to the common promise.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A software license answers different questions about copying, modification, and reuse.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The provider contract sets another relationship, including the obligations attached to delivering a service.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Keeping these instruments distinct is a concrete contribution of the book.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Open code alone cannot establish the voice, exit, and benefit its proposal demands.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The argument refuses to treat decentralization as a way to escape difficult human behavior.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Abuse, manipulation, unpaid maintenance, and moderation conflicts remain inside open networks.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Communities need resources and procedures that survive disagreement, not only an attractive founding promise.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Different revenue sources introduce different dependencies, so finance belongs inside the governance discussion.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The commons chapters connect this institutional work to the internet’s accumulated public knowledge.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: They explain why copying a platform’s features cannot reproduce a durable community.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Readers encounter the obligations behind the alternative, rather than merely a declaration against existing companies.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The next question concerns the system deciding what deserves your attention.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book proposes personal AI whose recommendation policy remains under the user’s control.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A person could inspect priorities instead of accepting one platform’s engagement objective.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Yet an obedient filter might reinforce an echo chamber or quietly become another gatekeeper.
